newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Air Force crew witnessed India crash.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Air Force crew witnessed India crash.

text.p: The crew of a U.S. Air Force cargo plane flying into New Delhi witnessed the mid-air collision of two airliners near India's capital on Tuesday, the Air Force said.

"They did see it," said Maj. Debra Millett, an Air Force spokeswoman at the Pentagon. Other officials said crew members of the Air Force C-141 cargo plane, which was approaching Delhi at the time of the accident, will be made available for interviews in Delhi later.
Nearly 350 people were feared dead when a Saudi Boeing 747 and a Kazakhstan airliner collided west of New Delhi, the Press Trust of India reported.
The Air Force said in Washington that the C-141 had been headed into New Delhi to deliver a load of supplies for the U.S. embassy at the time of the incident.
